inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing museum collections management system
Actual object records and condition information
outputs: Checked object and proposed-loan evidence with unresolved gaps

steps.what: Assess the actual collection loan's institutional value, condition constraints and acceptable terms
inputs: Institution's actual collection and delegation policies
outputs: Curator's actual negotiating position and authority limits

steps.what: Negotiate the actual collection loan terms with the counterparty
outputs: Proposed final negotiated terms subject to final authorization

steps.what: Prepare the actual final loan agreement and authorization entry using existing object and counterparty fields
outputs: Complete final draft agreement and authorization entry

steps.what: Review the complete final loan agreement, authorization entry, exact terms and recipients within delegated authority
inputs: Complete final agreement and authorization entry
Actual delegated authority and recipient identity
outputs: Exact checked final agreement and authorized decision ready to record

steps.what: Record authorization of the exact checked collection loan in the existing collections system
inputs: Exact authorization entry and agreement checked in s5
outputs: Recorded authorization linked to the exact loan agreement

tasks.design: Reuse verified {OPS_SYSTEM} object fields in the actual approved {DOCS} loan form. The curator negotiates and checks the complete final agreement before the separate authorization record and {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Re-entering verified collection and counterparty facts adds handling to negotiating and authorizing a loan.
tasks.enabler_now: Native collections-system fields and approved document forms can reuse exact facts.
tasks.still_hard: Collection value, condition constraints, acceptable terms and actual authorization remain institutional judgments.
tasks.human_edge: The curator negotiates defensible terms and owns the authorized collection decision.

ambition.what: Reduce factual entry in existing collection transactions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collections-system fields and approved agreement templates can reuse verified object facts without choosing transaction terms.

assumptions: Unmeasured collection-loan negotiation and authorization episode, not a universal baseline for purchases, sales or exchanges. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Collection owners maintain object records and the counterparty supplies the actual request; s1 counts collection and verification, s2 appraisal and s3 actual negotiation. Missing ownership or condition facts require manual resolution, not inferred authority.

This episode assumes the curator has actual delegated authority for this loan. If another authority is required, that person must review the complete final version before authorization; their work must be added rather than treated as free.

s4 includes actual agreement and authorization-entry preparation. s5 reviews the complete final terms. s6 and s7 are distinct gated immediate actions, each fully retained with no saving. Changes to terms, entry or recipient invalidate the corresponding gate.

Native form reuse comes first; equivalent existing fields earn no new benefit. Physical transport, payment and receipt are separate downstream work, not hidden in negotiation or authorization. Gross 3.8 minus 1.5 upkeep gives 2.3 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual transaction authority and form reuse
research_questions: Which facts are retyped into final agreements today?

incremental.description: Maintain object-field mappings and the approved agreement form

Exact complete agreement and counterparty recipient checked in s5, matching s6 authorization; changes require renewed checking

tasks.short: Write and review institutional and scholarly materials

steps.what: Collect and verify actual collection, activity and financial sources for the institutional report
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing museum collections and activity records
outputs: Checked reporting sources with actual coverage and gaps

steps.what: Assemble actual report tables and institutional fields from the checked sources using declared reporting rules
inputs: Explicit reporting period, field mappings and category rules
outputs: Staged report tables and factual sections with missing fields flagged

steps.what: Write and review the actual institutional report narrative and interpretation
inputs: Curator's actual interpretation and documented explanations

loop.input: Checked reporting facts and curator-authored explanations
loop.output: Draft narrative with source-linked claims and explicit gaps
loop.check: Curator checks every claim and edits interpretation against actual sources
loop.stop: Unsupported claims, missing figures or invented explanations require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative explanations need semantic drafting beyond exact report fields

steps.what: Check the complete final report's figures, claims, references, confidentiality and actual review status
outputs: Complete checked final report with actual approval status

steps.what: Save the exact checked institutional report in the existing document record
inputs: Exact final report checked in s4
outputs: Saved written institutional report with honest review status

tasks.design: Configure native {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS} assembly from actual checked {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP} sources, then bound narrative drafting to the curator's actual explanations. The curator reviews the complete final report before saving its exact written version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated factual compilation and narrative redrafting add work to institutional reporting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mappings handle exact fields; a bounded draft can express actual documented explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Reporting significance, collection context and defensible explanations remain the curator's work.
tasks.human_edge: The curator decides what the institution's activities mean and checks what the report claims.

ambition.what: Reduce handling in existing institutional writing.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for finance, collection-data and drafting-context consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reporting templates can assemble actual fields and a bounded prose draft can express supplied explanations subject to full checking.

assumptions: Unmeasured institutional-report writing episode, not a universal mix of grants, articles and publicity. Other document types require their actual requirements and observed work mix. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Collection and activity owners maintain actual records; finance supplies actual approved figures. s1 counts collection, verification and capture of the mapped report inputs. Missing facts stop s2 for manual resolution rather than invented figures.

s3 counts the curator's actual explanation authorship and draft editing; no completed interpretation is assumed free. Narrative drafting uses only the actually permitted context. s4 checks the entire final report against actual sources.

Use native assembly first. Existing equivalent reports and templates are baseline and earn no extra benefit. The saved report carries its actual pending or approved status; no external submission or publication is hidden here. Any required institutional approval reviews the complete final version.
Same-system saving earns no saving. Gross 40 minus 4 upkeep gives 36 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current automatic tables and document templates
research_questions: Which report tables are still compiled by hand?
Which explanations must the curator author before drafting?

already_counted.description: Retained source capture, narrative authorship and editing, and complete final report checking

incremental.description: Maintain reporting mappings and permitted narrative context and check changed source formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete report and actual review status checked in s4; changed figures or wording require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 30 factual compilation plus 10 narrative handling = 40 gross, minus 4 upkeep = 36 net. Existing equivalent reporting reduces additional benefit.

steps.what: Design the actual tour or educational session for its audience, collection and learning purpose
inputs: Actual institutional facilities and collection access constraints
outputs: Authored session structure and actual teaching choices

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual approved object facts and existing educational material
inputs: Actual chosen objects and approved educational sources
outputs: Checked source material for the planned session

steps.what: Prepare the actual session handout or teaching notes and check the complete final content
inputs: Checked object facts and approved reusable material

steps.what: Save the exact checked session material in the existing document workspace
Organize and conduct the actual tour, workshop or educational session with participants
inputs: Actual session structure and checked material
outputs: Participants receive the actual session and discussion

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} object views and approved {DOCS} material blocks to prepare the actual session notes. Keep audience-specific design, complete material checking and delivery with the curator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source retrieval and note formatting add preparation around actual educational work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing collection views and document blocks can reuse checked facts and approved material.
tasks.still_hard: Audience needs, object interpretation and live teaching require the curator.
tasks.human_edge: The curator connects the institution's materials to participants' questions and understanding.

ambition.what: Reduce handling in actual educational-session preparation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collection views and reusable document blocks can reduce source retrieval and formatting for actual educational material.

assumptions: Unmeasured educational episode with actual prepared session material, not a new report after every tour. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

s1 counts actual learning design and teaching choices. Collection owners maintain object facts; s2 counts retrieval and source checking. s3 counts actual note authorship, adaptation and complete final checking; no free finished lesson is assumed.
Native retrieval and material reuse come first; equivalent existing views and blocks earn no new gain. Same-system save is immediate with no saving.

The actual participants and facilities are already arranged in this episode. No hidden booking, registration notice, participant email or external material publication is introduced. Any actual required send needs its own checked final-version gate.
Gross 5.8 minus 1.5 upkeep gives 4.3 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
research_questions: Which source facts and material blocks are repeatedly copied?

incremental.description: Maintain approved educational blocks and collection-source links

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete session material checked in s3; edits require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 2 retrieval plus 3.8 material-handling hours = 5.8 gross, minus 1.5 upkeep = 4.3 net. Design and delivery remain retained.

inputs: Existing approved service information and financing priorities
outputs: Current checked institution information ready for the event

inputs: Actual curator's relationship and authority limits
outputs: Actual service promotion, financing discussions and community relationships

tasks.human_edge: The curator represents the institution and understands community needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-document links can reduce retrieval of approved institution information without replacing event participation.

assumptions: Unmeasured event episode with actual information retrieval; shares are independent of the prompt prior. Already available information earns no lookup saving.
Institution owners produce approved information; s1 counts retrieval and checking. s2 counts the actual event, financing discussion and relationship work.

No required contact report, donor record, follow-up email, financing application or commitment is established in this attendance episode. Those writes or sends are not invented or assumed free. No event booking or calendar setup is charged per conversation.
No new financing promise or institutional decision is generated. Gross 3 minus 1 upkeep gives 2 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
